groups.name: Code review
groups.description: Read the change with the code in front of you, and decide before it merges.

visual-review.tagline: Review a change on a local web page. Comment on each finding, one screen at a time. The comments drive what happens next.

changelog.title: First release: /visual-review
changelog.description: The collection opens with one skill. Review a PR, a commit, two branches or your uncommitted changes on a local page, and turn your comments into the next step.
